_description: Single taxable brokerage account — withdrawals taxed at flat LTCG rate. Verifies LTCG tax is applied on top of ordinary income tax.
_rationale: 500k taxable, 50k/yr spending, no other income, 0% return, 0% inflation, Florida. Taxable withdrawal of ~50k taxed at 15% flat LTCG = $7,500 LTCG tax. No ordinary income, so no federal bracket tax. Total tax = $7,500. Gross withdrawal = spending + tax = $57,500. But then LTCG on $57,500 = $8,625. Iterate: need $58,625, LTCG = $8,794... converges near $58,824 withdrawal, $8,824 tax.
name: Taxable Only
